intro: A Juggernaught is an enormous, heavily armored battleship bristling with heavy naval cannons. Originally engineered by ogres to serve as the iron core of the Old Horde's fleet during the Second War, these floating fortresses were built to pulverize coastal strongholds and trade routes. Their massive iron plating and siege-grade broadsides make them legendary instruments of naval warfare.

p: Orcs were not traditionally a seafaring culture, so when the Horde required a fleet capable of crossing the Great Sea and contesting the Alliance's naval superiority during the Second War, they relied heavily on ogre ingenuity. The resulting craft—the ogre juggernaught—became the backbone of the Horde armada. Though vastly slower and less nimble than swift troll destroyers, these behemoths carried immense plating and devastating broadside batteries that could shatter Alliance hulls and smash shore fortifications to rubble.
